snippet.title: Midnight Crane | Awesome Retro Arcade Psychological Horror Game | PC
snippet.description:
Midnight Crane | Awesome Retro Arcade Psychological Horror Game | PC
#horrorgaming #pcgaming #gaming #indiegame #atmospheric #arcade 

Buy Game - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3841220/Midnight_Crane/

A psychological horror game where you spend a night in the shoes of an arcade worker named Marcus. Win prizes on the crane machine and shoot some hoops. Just make sure to keep the doors locked.


CAN YOU SURIVE THE NIGHT?
You receive a fun lucrative offer from your boss that involves winning crane game prizes. Determined to meet the required amount of prizes, you decide to stay after hours in order to complete it. Be wary of what lurks behind. Don't just look. Listen. The silence hides more than the shadows. 

GAMEPLAY
First person narrative walking simulator.

Survival horror where you defend against break ins.

Interactive Dialogue

Crane games, basketball, ice hockey, etc.

Atmospheric environment.
